Name: StrangeStarfruit's Portraits
Author: StrangeStarfruit
Description:
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/d/db/Starfruit.png[/img][size=6]  [/size][size=6][b]StrangeStarfruit's Portraits[/b]  [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/d/db/Starfruit.png[/img][/size][size=4]
[/size]
My portraits of the Stardew Valley love interests, Krobus and optional matching Maru sprites. The rest of the Stardew NPC's portraits are currently in progress! 


[b][size=5]Mod compatibility[/size]
[/b]
This mod is [b]incompatible[/b] with other portrait mods that [b]do not have a config file[/b]. If Maru's sprite recolour ﻿is enabled StrangeStarfruit's Portraits is also [b]incompatible[/b] with mods that replace her sprites [b]without a config file[/b]. Mods that replace portraits or Maru's sprites without a config file will overwrite this mod by default.

StrangeStarfruit's Portraits is [b]compatible[/b] with mods that replace portraits or Maru's sprites that [b]have a config file[/b]. You can enable and disable which portraits/sprites that you want from each mod by editing the config files or using Generic Mod Config Menu. How to edit the config is explained below.

[b][size=3]This sounds a bit confusing, but TL;DR[/size] [/b]what it means is that if a mod is replacing the same assets as this mod without the ability to enable and disable it using the config, the mods will clash and be incompatible with each other.

I have not found any other incompatibilities in testing so far, please let me know if you come across any!


[size=5][b]How to configure [/b][/size][size=4](How to enable/disable individual portraits)
[/size]
[size=2][b]All NPCs portraits and Maru's resprite are enabled by default. [/b]
[/size]
[size=4][b]Option 1[/b][/size]
Open the "config.json" file with a text editing program and edit the NPC's field to say either "true" or "false". True means on/enabled, false means off/disabled. Save once done.

[size=4][b]Option 2[/b] [/size][size=3](Simple)[/size]
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily enable and disable individual portraits while in game.


[size=5][b]How to install[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Extract "﻿﻿[CP] StrangeStarfruit's Portraits" into your mods folder.
[*]Run Stardew Valley using SMAPI.
[/list]
